scripts/swarm/publish.py:scripts.swarm.p.reason: Drops the head name from the fetch of the open pull request branch (survivor reported by the mutation job on head c694102). Under the default +refs/heads/* refspec both forms update refs/remotes/origin/<head>, force-pushed heads included, and that ref is all descends and set-upstream-to read; under a narrowed refspec tracking setup fails either way, so the named head only adds a FETCH_HEAD entry nothing reads.
